packs.title: Mountains, Missions and Art
packs.promise: Explore El Paso through desert landscapes, living places of worship, art and borderland history.

q.s: Let an artwork inspire an original visual relationship.
st: Choose an artwork and credit its maker and title.
Notice a relationship of color or line.
Create a different subject in a small sketch or written scene, following gallery rules or working afterward.

q.s: Compare two discoveries through the center’s explanations.
st: Check admission requirements before visiting and choose two available exhibits.
Follow their instructions and record one observation at each.
Use the interpretation to explain one difference between what you observed.

q.s: Learn a documented detail about diplomacy and its human effects.
st: Use current park interpretation or the NPS account of the Chamizal agreement.
Record one fact about the agreement and one stated effect on residents.
Keep the source with your note and add a question.

packs.title: Plazas and Small Details
packs.promise: Explore downtown El Paso through architectural details, creative prompts and short plaza connections.

q.s: Use theatre architecture to frame an original idea.
st: Keep the entrance and ticket queues clear.
Notice two exterior shapes or decorative lines.
Draw an original frame for an imaginary scene, changing their arrangement.

q.s: Look closely at the public face of a historic hotel.
st: Use the public sidewalk and leave arrivals clear.
Find a repeated detail, a contrasting texture and a curved shape.
Record which detail you noticed last.

q.s: Make a new composition from a museum’s public face.
st: Choose a clear public exterior view.
Notice a relationship between a broad surface and an opening.
Create an original arrangement that changes their proportions.
